relationships.subject: BIBN4096BS
relationships.evidence_quote: the CGRP receptor antagonist BIBN4096BS lessens lower urinary tract symptoms and prevents the development of pelvic allodynia in mice inoculated with uropathogenic Escherichia coli (UPEC)

relationships.subject: Suburothelial fibroblasts
relationships.evidence_quote: identified a population of suburothelial fibroblasts in the lamina propria, a region where afferent fibers containing CGRP terminate, that expresses the canonical CGRP receptor components Calcrl and Ramp1

key_findings: CGRP receptor antagonist BIBN4096BS reduces LUTS and pelvic allodynia in UPEC cystitis without altering bacterial load
Suburothelial fibroblasts express Calcrl and Ramp1
